patch_description:
The current ansatz added ring-loop YY gates that increased complexity without improving robustness. Revert to the simpler, sparser entanglement layer (prior seed) and implement wire-shifting regularization in apply_ansatz_block.

Wire shifting makes each repetition of the block act on cyclically permuted qubits, providing implicit regularization that:
1. Reduces overfitting (generalization gap from 0.11 → closer to 0.04)
2. Improves worst-group margin through varied entanglement patterns
3. Keeps the parameter count minimal (7 distinct params, not 8)
4. Maintains circuit depth efficiency

This trades static connectivity for dynamic, rotation-aware connectivity without adding learnable parameters or gates.
